purpose: Define PortfolioCore as the identity-linked registry of references, evidence pointers and descriptive metadata used to present verifiable work/history without owning MeritCore calculations.

topics.name: Portfolio Registry
topics.purpose: Define PortfolioCore as the identity-linked registry of references, evidence pointers and descriptive metadata used to present verifiable work/history without owning MeritCore calculations.

semantics.owner_rule: Each Portfolio belongs to one explicit IdentityCore identity.
semantics.registry_rule: Portfolio entries have explicit identities and typed evidence/reference semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: Portfolio identity is distinct from IdentityCore identity while linked to it.
semantics.merit_rule: PortfolioCore does not calculate merits, points, Tier, recommendations or trust.
semantics.project_rule: Project evidence is referenced by exact Project identity rather than copied as new Project semantics.
semantics.presentation_rule: Portfolio views are projections of PortfolioCore records and linked evidence.

invariants.rule: PortfolioCore represents explicit identity-linked references and evidence metadata; it never manufactures competence, merit, trust or authorization from presentation content.

hard_gates.condition: portfolio entry duplicates Project semantic ownership
portfolio owner inferred from display name
portfolio identity conflated with IdentityCore identity

references.purpose: Portfolio belongs to an explicit identity.

prose.summary: Define PortfolioCore as the identity-linked registry of references, evidence pointers and descriptive metadata used to present verifiable work/history without owning MeritCore calculations.
